name: duxsoup-etl
description: LinkedIn ETL system for DuxSoup webhook data

scripts.audit:canonical-id: node -e "const mongoose=require('mongoose');const Person=require('./src/models/person');(async()=>{const uri=process.env.MONGODB_URI||'mongodb://localhost:27017/duxsoup-etl';await mongoose.connect(uri);const missing=await Person.countDocuments({$or:[{canonical_id:{$exists:false}},{canonical_id:null},{canonical_id:''}]});const total=await Person.countDocuments({});const sample=await Person.find({canonical_id:{$exists:true}}).limit(3).select('_id canonical_id aliases').lean();console.log({total,missing,sample});await mongoose.disconnect();})();"

author: Mike Hare
